scripts.ship:engine: flyctl deploy --config apps/server/fly.toml --dockerfile apps/server/Dockerfile --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) .
scripts.ship:admin: pnpm --filter @trail/admin build && flyctl deploy --config apps/admin-server/fly.toml --dockerfile apps/admin-server/Dockerfile --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) .
scripts.ship:landing: cd apps/landing && BUILD_OUT_DIR=deploy npx tsx build.ts && flyctl deploy --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --config fly.toml .
scripts.ship:docs: cd apps/docs && BUILD_OUT_DIR=deploy npm run build && flyctl deploy --remote-only --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --config fly.toml .
scripts.ship:widget: cd apps/widget && npm run build && flyctl deploy --remote-only --build-arg GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --config fly.toml .
